correctness.rationale: PASS: Normalize target p by y_i=x_i/p_i; A_ij=S_ij p_j. If Q_i is homogeneous quadratic, the target equilibrium fixes Q_i(1)=-r_i-sum_jA_ij; Euler homogeneity forces every Jacobian H to obey H1=w with w_i=-2r_i-sum_jA_ij. Conversely any such H is realizable by a partner-symmetric real tensor, for example the submitted quadratic formula Q_i(y)=(sum_j y_j)(g_i dot y)/n-q_i(sum_j y_j)^2/n^2, with g_i=H_i-A_i and sum g_i=2q_i. If w is constant c>=0, H has eigenvalue c and is not Hurwitz; if c<0, H=cI works. If w is nonconstant, choose f^T1=1, f^T(w+1)=0 and H=-I+(w+1)f^T. The rank-one correction squares to zero, so every eigenvalue is -1 and the construction realizes H at p. Independent exact arithmetic checked this square-zero identity and prescribed row sums for several nonconstant rational vectors. The proof covers n=1 and all real unrestricted tensors, not sign constraints.
